title: How confessions can keep language models honest
summary: OpenAI researchers are testing “confessions,” a method that trains models to admit when they make mistakes or act undesirably, helping improve AI honesty, transparency, and trust in model outputs.
body: OpenAI researchers are testing “confessions,” a method that trains models to admit when they make mistakes or act undesirably, helping improve AI honesty, transparency, and trust in model outputs.
summaryZh: OpenAI研究人员正在测试一种名为“Confessions”的方法，旨在训练模型主动承认错误或不当行为。该技术旨在增强AI系统的透明度与用户信任，是模型对齐领域的重要探索。原始信息显示：OpenAI researchers are testing “confessions,” a method that trains models to admit when they make mistakes or act undesirably, helping improve AI honesty, transparency, and trust in model outputs.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“How confessions can keep language models honest”。其重要性主要体现在：“Confessions”方法为提升模型对齐与可信度提供了新的技术路径。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
